source: Soundscape Annotation Atelier, repertorio originale di notazione spettromorfologica (Fase 3)

signs.name: Impulso
signs.svg: <circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2.5" fill="currentColor" /><line x1="12" y1="7" x2="12" y2="20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
signs.description: Oggetto breve e secco, attacco senza durata (mantenimento impulsivo).
signs.description_en: Short, dry object, an attack with no duration (impulsive sustainment).

signs.name: Tenuto
signs.svg: <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" />
signs.description: Suono mantenuto a energia stabile (mantenimento tenuto).
signs.description_en: Sound held at stable energy (sustained sustainment).

signs.name: Massa tonica
signs.svg: <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.4" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.5" fill="currentColor" />

signs.name: Massa complessa
signs.description: Fascio di altezze ravvicinate, massa nodale o complessa.
signs.description_en: Bundle of close pitches, nodal or complex mass.

signs.name: Rumore
signs.svg: <g fill="currentColor"><circle cx="5" cy="8" r="1" /><circle cx="9" cy="14" r="1" /><circle cx="13" cy="7" r="1" /><circle cx="17" cy="13" r="1" /><circle cx="20" cy="9" r="1" /><circle cx="7" cy="17" r="1" /><circle cx="15" cy="17" r="1" /></g>

signs.name: Crescendo
signs.svg: <path d="M3 12 L21 6 M3 12 L21 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" />

signs.name: Decrescendo
signs.svg: <path d="M21 12 L3 6 M21 12 L3 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" />

signs.name: Attacco-risonanza
signs.description: Crescita rapida e lunga risonanza, profilo ad arco.
signs.description_en: Fast rise and long resonance, arch-shaped profile.

signs.name: Profilo ascendente
signs.svg: <path d="M4 19 L20 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" /><path d="M20 6 l-5.5 1.2 M20 6 l-1.2 5.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />

signs.name: Profilo discendente
signs.svg: <path d="M4 6 L20 19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" /><path d="M20 19 l-5.5 -1.2 M20 19 l-1.2 -5.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />

signs.name: Grana
signs.svg: <g fill="currentColor"><circle cx="4" cy="12" r="1.2" /><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.2" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.2" /><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="1.2" /><circle cx="20" cy="12" r="1.2" /></g>
signs.description_en: Granular micro-structure of the sound matter.

signs.name: Allure
signs.svg: <path d="M3 12 Q6 6 9 12 T15 12 T21 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" />
signs.description: Oscillazione regolare dell'energia o dell'altezza (allure, vibrato).
signs.description_en: Regular oscillation of energy or pitch (allure, vibrato).

signs.name: Gesto
signs.svg: <path d="M3 18 C 8 18, 9 6, 14 6 S 21 8, 21 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
signs.description: Movimento direzionale e teso, di tipo gestuale.
signs.description_en: Directional, tense movement, gestural in kind.

signs.name: Trama
signs.svg: <path d="M3 8 H21 M3 12 H21 M3 16 H21" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2" />
signs.description: Materia continua e non direzionale, di tipo tramato.
signs.description_en: Continuous, non-directional matter, textural in kind.
